d: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has delivered a blistering verdict on Brexit, declaring that Britain has "lost more than it has gained" and warning that the UK's isolation played into Russia's hands by weakening European unity and NATO. Ahead of Friday's UK-EU summit in Brussels, Burnham has called for a reset in relations with Europe, promising to pursue deals on trade, energy and youth mobility while putting Britain's economic interests first. He also outlined a broader foreign policy shift, reaffirming support for Ukraine and calling for stronger international alliances.
